title: Dispense a mash portion from a thumb-lever disher into a ramekin and return it to its tray
instruction: Dispense the mash portion cleanly into the centered ramekin by drawing the thumb lever, return the disher to its rest tray, and clear both grippers.
context: Portioning soft foods with a spring-lever disher is performed daily in home kitchens, cafeterias, and meal-prep lines, where a cohesive scoop sticks inside the bowl until the internal wiper sweeps past the rim. Because drawing a 30 mm spring rack while holding the loaded disher suspended over an unbolted ramekin pushes or tips the vessel unless steadied independently, one arm holds and positions the disher while the second draws the thumb tab to release the portion.
setup: A black silicone mat covers a 460 mm square of the table. A 155 g stainless thumb-lever disher (0.099 kg frame, 0.030 kg thumb rack, 0.026 kg wiper) rests on a steel and rubber rest tray at (0.30, -0.02) m with its 54 mm bowl mouth 104 mm over the table, a T-pommel grip sleeve on the handle, and the amber thumb tab on the left-arm side. The bowl carries a 65 g cohesive mash plug held until the rack reaches 27 mm of its 30 mm stroke (60 N/m spring) and clears the wiper detent so the wiper sweeps past 150 deg. A 95 g ceramic ramekin rests unbolted on a 9 mm rubber coaster at (0.24, 0.06) m, and a 280 g mash supply tub sits unbolted on its coaster at (0.44, -0.16) m. One fixed layout; arms start at ready pose.
scoring: Judged at the end of the trial; the run succeeds once 1.0 holds for 3.0 s. Measured at trial end with a scale, caliper/ruler, and angle gauge. 1.0: the wiper swept at least 150 deg (possible only once the rack clears its 27 mm detent), the 65 g mash plug sits in the ramekin (within 20 mm of its axis, 12 to 70 mm above the table), the ramekin stayed within 20 mm of its mark and 8 deg of upright, the supply tub stayed within 25 mm of its mark and 8 deg, the disher returned to its rest tray (within 45 mm XY, 40 mm height, and 15 deg of level), and both grippers are at least 45 mm clear of every scored body. 0.7: swept >= 150 deg and mash in ramekin with vessels intact, but disher unparked or a gripper within 45 mm. 0.4: swept >= 150 deg with vessels intact, but mash missed the ramekin. 0 otherwise (vessels displaced/tipped, or wiper under 150 deg from shaking/flipping without drawing the rack). Possible scores: 0.0, 0.4, 0.7, 1.0.
reset_notes: Wipe the bowls, press a fresh 65 g plug into the disher bowl with the wiper parked at 0 deg behind the rack detent, set the disher on its rest tray, and center both vessels on their coasters.
fidelity: Rigid-body simulation (PhysX, 20 Hz control). The disher is modelled with a 12-sided stainless bowl, 30 mm prismatic thumb rack (60 N/m return spring), 180 deg hinged internal wiper blocked physically at ~20 deg by the rack detent until full stroke, and a breakable cohesive bond on the 65 g mash plug released once rack >= 27 mm and wiper >= 150 deg. Soft food deformation is omitted.
